judgement.reason: This repository is the ClickHouse database server, and the selected image is ClickHouse Keeper, a coordination server that clients connect to on port 2181 rather than a web application; the image also installs a released package instead of building this source.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME "${DEFAULT_DATA_DIR}" (docker/keeper/Dockerfile), VOLUME /var/lib/clickhouse (docker/keeper/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The production image runs ClickHouse Keeper, which keeps its coordination logs and snapshots on local disk, and no shown setting moves that data to a managed service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Server binds only to a loopback address: listen(PORT, '127.0.0.1', () (.claude/skills/diff-review/server.mjs)
reviews.reason: The loopback bind is in a developer tool script under .claude/skills, which the keeper Dockerfile does not run, so it is not on the production path.
